subject: Confirmation of your flight booking
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on September 15th, 2021. Your flight details are as follows: Flight number XYZ123, Departure: 10:00 AM, Arrival: 3:00 PM. If you have any questions or need to make changes to your booking, please contact us at [contact email/phone]. Thank you for choosing our airline and we look forward to welcoming you on board. Best regards, The Airline Team
